field.label: Listen address
field.help: IP the daemon listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

field.label: Listen port
field.help: HTTP port for the netglance web UI. Default: 8473.

field.label: Scan interfaces
field.help: OPNsense interfaces to send ARP probes from. Pick the interfaces facing the LANs you want inventoried.

field.label: Scan interval (seconds)
field.help: How often the daemon scans the configured networks. Min 30s.

field.label: Networks to inventory
field.help: One row per CIDR. VLAN ID is informational (drives the badge in the netglance UI). Name is optional.
